```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"374701a2-c808-4317-9213-cb863516c878","commandId":"probe-1","operation":"run","heads":["5bee874feebe6ea883dda565c03401ad1d7b95bc","012ffb90c6c91afd0be84e73d07ce4a07a511c7a"],"command":"git rev-parse HEAD && git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -5 && echo '--- remote ---' && git ls-remote origin cornel/slit-readme-opisyvaet-funkcionalnost-kot-374701","timeoutSeconds":300}
```
